200.description: The buckets replaced the stored ones (version + 1), or equal them (nothing changed).

buckets.description: The stored buckets, in receipt order.

cpt.description: The critical pull time the units are due at (RFC 3339; answered in UTC).

quantity.description: Whole units due at the cpt.

total_quantity.description: The sum of every bucket's quantity.

received_at.description: When the current buckets were received; an identical receipt keeps it.

version.description: 1 for a first receipt, + 1 per receipt that changed the buckets.

201.description: A first receipt; the forecast is stored at version 1.

buckets.description: The stored buckets, in receipt order.

cpt.description: The critical pull time the units are due at (RFC 3339; answered in UTC).

quantity.description: Whole units due at the cpt.

total_quantity.description: The sum of every bucket's quantity.

received_at.description: When the current buckets were received; an identical receipt keeps it.

version.description: 1 for a first receipt, + 1 per receipt that changed the buckets.

400.description: Malformed JSON (a fractional quantity included) or a cpt that is not RFC 3339 (malformed-json, malformed-cpt).

409.description: The stored version moved twice while the receipt was applied (version-conflict); retry it.

422.description: No bucket (no-forecast-buckets), a bucket without cpt (missing-cpt) or quantity (missing-bucket-quantity), or a negative quantity (negative-bucket-quantity).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
